- **docs/sequence-diagrams/vaa-eapi-graphql-holidays-document-token-download.md**: DMAZE: HTTPS exact-host allowlist, no redirects, no user-info or loopback/private targets, 30-second timeout, bounded cancellation-aware 5 MB read, `application/pdf` plus `%PDF-` signature, and sanitized filename with `{documentId}.pdf` fallback.

The implementation has passed verification and remains `InProgress` until these points are answered.
